title: Pakistan Launches Deadly Air Strikes in Afghanistan, Killing Women and Children
detail: Pakistan launched deadly air strikes inside Afghan territory on October 1, 2026, with Afghan officials reporting women and children were killed in the attacks. The strikes mark a significant escalation in cross-border hostilities between the two countries, coming days after a similar series of Pakistani air strikes on September 24 that targeted sites in Kandahar, Paktia and Khost.

media.caption: Afghan officials say Pakistani air strikes killed women and children
